BiblicalUsage: Ra'eh is seeing — Job says to God, 'I am full of confusion; therefore see thou mine affliction.' It is not sight with the eyes but the seeing that notices and weighs a man's suffering.
TheologicalSignificance: This tells me that Job's plea still stands: the afflicted do not ask God to fix everything at once — they ask first that He see.
